meta.note: Existence = coverage>=10. CN: HCC1395 uses SEQC2 median_cn/cn_class (ground-truth); other samples have NO orthogonal CN -> rel_cov (n_reads/sample-median) is a crude depth/CN proxy + HP-structure zygosity (LOH/het/subhap). Cross-sample 'CN consistency' = whether the same position has the same zygosity across cancers.

cross_sample_cn_consistency.interpretation: zygosity_consistent positions have the SAME LOH/het structure across all 6 cancers; low consistency => CN/zygosity is cancer-specific (each cancer its own CN profile).
